# FistGenerator

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Interaction.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Interaction.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Interaction/FistGenerator.cs#L74)

Builds a closed-hand pose from the shape of the hand itself, so nothing has to be authored for a
grabbable to be auto posed.

The closed pose is the far end of the auto pose search and almost never reached: a finger stops
where it meets the object, and only a finger that meets nothing at all closes the whole way. So
it does not need to be art, it needs to be a plausible fist.

Each finger flexes about an axis lying in the palm and square to the bone: the cross product
of the bone with the palm's normal. That is the hinge a finger actually has - a knuckle bends,
it does not steer - and because both terms are measured off the rig rather than assumed, it
comes out right for either hand and for a rig whose bone axes point wherever the artist left
them.

Turning each bone towards the middle of the palm instead, which is the obvious first thing to
try, splays the hand as it closes it. Only the middle finger points at the palm centre; every
other finger sits off to one side, so the axis picks up a component about the palm normal and
the finger swings sideways as it curls.

### Generate(HandSkeleton, IReadOnlyDictionary\<string, Quaternion>, FistSettings) {#generate-handskeleton-quaternion-fistsettings}

Curls a hand into a fist and reads the result, leaving the hand as it found it.

Works on any skeleton, so the fist an authored grip starts from is the same fist a worn
hand would have made for itself.

```csharp
public static List<PosedBone> Generate(HandSkeleton hand, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, Quaternion> rest, FistSettings settings = null)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hand` | [`HandSkeleton`](/api/vrframework-interaction-runtime/HandSkeleton) | The bones to curl. |
| `rest` | `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, Quaternion>` | Local rotations to curl from, by bone name. Where the hand stands if null. |
| `settings` | [`FistSettings`](/api/vrframework-interaction-runtime/FistSettings) | Shape tuning. The defaults are used when this is null. |

**Returns** `List<PosedBone>` - The closed shape, or an empty list when there are no fingers to curl.
